doc: Grain: additive noise per grain cell (size x size document px, cell = floor(doc / size)), hash of (cell, seed) so it is deterministic and independent of the rendered region. kind 'noise': delta = (2u - 1) * amount/100 * 0.5 (uniform, +-0.5 at 100 %); kind 'film': approx gaussian (sum of 4 uniforms, sd 1) * amount/100 * 0.2 * 4 l (1 - l) with l the luma of the straight colour (strongest in midtones, 0 in pure black/white). colour=true: independent noise per channel, false: the same delta on r,g,b. Added to the straight colour (0..1) and clamped; alpha untouched, transparent pixels stay transparent.
